## What Pandas API should be supported?

Describe the Pandas method or pattern you'd like nw-migrate to handle.

## Example

```python
# Before (Pandas)
df.some_method(...)

# After (Narwhals)
df.narwhals_equivalent(...)
```

## Difficulty assessment

- [ ] EASY — direct 1:1 method rename
- [ ] MEDIUM — exists in Narwhals but needs expression API
- [ ] HARD — no Narwhals equivalent

## Additional context

Any relevant links to Narwhals docs or discussion.
